title: AI-ML for Educators
overview: Empower teachers and academic leaders to understand, apply, and teach artificial intelligence and machine learning concepts with confidence. This course blends theory with practical tools tailored for education.
details: Learn AI & ML fundamentals with a focus on pedagogy
Explore ethical and responsible AI in education
Use AI tools for grading, feedback, and content generation
Design interactive ML demonstrations for classroom use
Create AI-infused lesson plans and learning activities
modules: AI & ML Concepts Simplified for Educators
AI Ethics & Bias in the Classroom
Using AI Tools to Enhance Teaching

title: GenAI in Classrooms
overview: Discover how generative AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, and others can be safely and effectively integrated into classrooms. This program is designed for educators seeking to modernize learning experiences using GenAI.
details: Understand how generative AI works and its implications in education
Use AI to personalize learning paths and generate teaching materials
Explore classroom-safe GenAI tools and policies
Design activities leveraging AI for creativity and collaboration
Assess AI-generated content and promote digital literacy
modules: Introduction to Generative AI for Educators
AI Tools for Assessment and Feedback
Ethical Use of GenAI in Schools
